name: Change fund lineup
description: Add, remove or map investment options in the plan's lineup.

steps.name: Validate fund change request
steps.guidance: The new lineup must be complete, keep exactly one QDIA, and give an effective date.

steps.name: Review AI-proposed fund mapping
steps.guidance: An AI agent has proposed where each removed fund's balances should move. Check each mapping against the funds' risk and return. Mapping to funds with similar characteristics keeps the fiduciary protection of a qualified change. Edit anything that's wrong, then approve. Only the approved mapping is used.
checklist: Each removed fund maps to a fund with similar risk/return
QDIA unchanged or replacement is QDIA-eligible
steps.regulatoryRef: ERISA 404(c)(4) qualified change in investment options

steps.name: Check approved fund mapping
steps.guidance: Every removed fund must be mapped exactly once, to a fund in the new lineup.

steps.name: Send fund change notice to sponsor for participant distribution
steps.guidance: Participants must be notified 30 to 60 days before a qualified change in investment options. Check that the effective date leaves at least 30 days.

steps.name: Apply new lineup on recordkeeper
steps.guidance: Submits the new lineup to the recordkeeper.
